title: Statement
description: What an engagement came to: the packs bought from the consumer's wallet and the calls run, refunds the provider recorded, the commission and the provider's net.

price_per_call.description: Amount as a decimal string, e.g. "0.40". Never a float.

plan_id.description: Plan the engagement was agreed under.

packs_bought.description: Packs bought under the engagement: each by a succeeded run with a verified receipt.

calls.description: Succeeded runs with a verified receipt, including those using a pack's calls.

gross.description: The packs bought, at their prices, as a decimal string, e.g. "8.00".

refunded.description: Refunds the provider recorded, as a decimal string.

revenue.description: gross less refunded, as a decimal string.

commission_rate.description: EuKollab commission rate as a decimal string, e.g. "0.12".

commission.description: The network's commission on revenue, kept from what the provider earns, as a decimal string.

provider_net.description: revenue less commission: what the provider earns, as a decimal string.

settlement.description: wallet: the consumer paid from its EuKollab wallet; the provider is paid out from its earnings.
